answer: haven is the registry cell where key, endpoint and branch must coincide, so each pigment collides instead of twinning. Admission needs a quorum spanning pairwise-disjoint branches, and branch i can sign one cell per epoch. The ith pigment burns sonnet equal to its i−1 crossings with live cells; n heads owe n(n−1)/2 sonnet, bound to those exact cells, not lendable or parallel. It breaks if haven dedups weakly, branches are rented, or sonnet transfers.
